details.method: Bind derived modules to source documents in a trusted domain table and evaluate current source access for every direct and transitive native read.
details.when: Private source content is copied into immutable native snapshots exposed through generic content and composition APIs.
details.counterexample: Tenant membership alone is insufficient for existing private documents; a binding inside caller-supplied content is not an authority record. Legitimately public standalone modules need no source-document mapping.
details.trial_plan: At future adoption test unshared readers and editors against heads, revisions, objects and direct/transitive compositions; share then revoke, restart and replay. Unknown or forged bindings must fail closed while authorized historical replay preserves original bytes.
